projectName: Audit and Strengthen Backend RAG and Qdrant Pipelines

stories.title: RAG Response & Citation Integrity
stories.description: Ensure zero citations means verification.citations_verified=false on all fallback, abstain, and terminal paths. Enforce invariant in PipelineResult and fix first_person_bridge abstain path. Clean up trailing rate_limit imports.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero citations never carries citations_verified=True in verification dict or PipelineResult
PipelineResult coerces citations_verified to False if citations is empty
first_person_bridge._decline_as_abstain sets citations_verified=False
Duplicate imports removed from rate_limit.py
All verification coverage tests pass

stories.title: Qdrant Retrieval Schema Contract Validation
stories.description: Enforce fail-closed validation for named dense and sparse vectors matching configured search lanes before queries execute.
acceptanceCriteria: Collection without named dense vector is rejected at startup and search initialization
Collection without named sparse vector is rejected when hybrid search is active
Clear fail-closed exception raised rather than raw transport error
Existing tests in test_qdrant_dimension_validation.py pass

stories.title: Rate Limiting Identity Hardening
stories.description: Ensure secondary token-bucket subject strictly uses server-resolved tenant context and normalized peer IP, never client-controlled identity headers.
acceptanceCriteria: X-User-Id header cannot bypass or partition token bucket
Peer IP is validated and compressed via ipaddress
Redis and local fallback token buckets use identical key schema
test_token_bucket_fallback.py passes

stories.title: Serving Contracts & Verbatim Quote Integrity
stories.description: Ensure first-person teaching bodies contain strictly verbatim quotes in source order plus permitted attribution; weak-match status and safety remain metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: No weak-match labels or section headings concatenated into answer bodies
Directness status preserved exclusively in status, is_direct_answer, and verification.direct metadata
route_metadata.fp_served is True only for served teaching clips, never on error/crisis/abstain
Tests in test_first_person_bridge.py, test_first_person_context_harness.py, and test_first_person_related_label_not_in_body.py pass

stories.title: Speaker Attribution Provenance Gate
stories.description: Require recorded voice evidence provenance before claiming verified speaker voice; unverified clips degrade to channel-shared attribution.
acceptanceCriteria: Raw boolean speaker_verified without evidence provenance does not claim verified speaker
Automated candidate evidence is distinguished from human certification
Unverified clips use 'shared in <channel>' attribution
Tests in test_first_person_payload_contract.py pass

stories.title: Ingestion Isolation & Safe Rollback
stories.description: Carry target collection override through existence checks, backup, restore, and rollback deletion. Fail closed if backup fails or probe is uncertain.
acceptanceCriteria: _backup_before_reindex and _rollback_reindex operate strictly on selected target_qdrant / qdrant_override
Backup failure on existing source aborts ingestion fail-closed instead of overwriting unprotected
Probe exception is not treated as absence / new source
Snapshots namespaced by target collection to prevent collision
New test matrix in test_scratch_ingest_rollback.py passes

stories.title: Corpus Governance & OKF Manifest Gating
stories.description: Make source eligibility explicit and versioned. Require manifest validation for OKF entries and retrieved documents; correct stale OKF empty comment.
acceptanceCriteria: OKF store loader and vector matcher reject unmanifested or unreviewed entries
stable or licensed alone does not imply clearance
Stale 'empty index' comment in config.py updated to reflect current compiled artifact and governance gate
test_okf_load_gate.py and test_corpus_governance_manifest.py pass

stories.title: Evaluation Honesty & Metric Separation
stories.description: Eliminate proxy pass fabrication in evaluation runs. Mark unavailable judge metrics as None / unmeasured rather than duplicating concept_overlap_score.
acceptanceCriteria: run_golden_eval.py does not duplicate concept_overlap_score into faithfulness, relevancy, precision, recall
Unavailable judge metrics are set to None / 'unmeasured'
Concept overlap score is reported honestly as its own metric
test_gold_eval.py and test_no_fabricated_scores.py pass

stories.title: Telemetry Privacy & Data Redaction
stories.description: Prevent raw user prompts, assistant completions, transcripts, retrieved docs, credentials, and internal safety state from leaking into OpenTelemetry spans.
acceptanceCriteria: Span attribute sanitizer strips prompt/completion text and raw transcripts
Allowlisted metadata (timing, token counts, route, trace ID) preserved
New privacy and allowlist tests pass

stories.title: Full Regression & Docker Safety Verification
stories.description: Execute comprehensive backend test suite, verify static docker/ops safety gates, and verify all invariants hold.
acceptanceCriteria: Full backend test suite passes with zero failures
Static compose, dockerignore, ops gates, and snapshot manager tests pass
No Qdrant alias or collection writes to live data occurred
FIRST_PERSON_CONTEXT_HARNESS_ENABLED remains false
